convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'DSSBressert' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management, requiring custom indicator replication and library function replacement in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation

other_exits: Sell position closed when UpValue crosses above DnValue (sell exit on buy signal); Buy position closed when DnValue crosses above UpValue (buy exit on sell signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (abs value); positive MM value = deposit fraction for risk-based sizing; logic handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses lagging bar comparison: UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] confirms trend direction on the previous bar, then UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0] on the bar before that confirms a crossover occurred. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from bar 1 (completed bar) and bar 2 (the one before it). Signal time is set to last bar date + one full timeframe period, which approximates the next bar open time. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean gates allow disabling specific trade directions. Recount flag ensures data is re-fetched on failure. Close operations execute before open operations on each tick.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate the DSSBressert custom indicator logic (double smoothed stochastic: EMA of stochastic with periods 8 and 13). Must replace TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_) with Python equivalents. The crossover detection uses a two-bar lookback pattern (bar[1] direction confirmed, bar[0] crossover trigger) which must be faithfully replicated. The conditional MM sizing logic (negative=lot, positive=fraction) needs careful implementation. No digit adjustment is performed in the EA itself - SL/TP are passed as-is to the trade library.
